Name: Skip Cutscanes
Author: Zexu2K
Description:
Allows you to skip cutscene, by pressing "[b][color=#ffff00]R [/color]+ [color=#ffff00] Shift[/color][/b]" on yours keybord during cutscane!
There is one problem, sometimes you don't get the item that you get during the cutscene. For example, when Leah brings you a sculpture you don't get it, but the fishing rod from Willie you do, it all depends on the cutscene, normally if you skip you wouldn't get it either, but you won't get the fishing rod, so I recommend it be cerful
